title: Mandatory notification fails to send - exception is caught
gherkin:
Feature: Mandatory Notification Exception Handling
  Scenario: Mandatory notification send failure triggers exception handling
    Given a mandatory notification is queued for delivery
    When the notification delivery service encounters an error
    Then an exception is raised
    And the exception is caught by the exception handler
    And the system logs the failure
rationale: Verifies that when a mandatory notification fails to send, the system properly catches and handles the exception rather than allowing it to propagate unchecked.
